---
title: "Download"
---

Each file is an R object (`.rds`), so read it with `readRDS()`.

| File | Network | Download |
|---|---|---|
| `kk-index-b-verified-network.rds` | definitions × sub-elements (list: `graph`, `biadjacency`) | [download](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olizardo/definitions-of-culture-two-mode/gh-pages/data/kk-index-b-verified-network.rds) |
| `kk-index-b-heading-network.rds` | definitions × headings (list: `graph`, `biadjacency`) | [download](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olizardo/definitions-of-culture-two-mode/gh-pages/data/kk-index-b-heading-network.rds) |
| `kk-index-b-works-sub-element-network.rds` | works × sub-elements (igraph) | [download](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olizardo/definitions-of-culture-two-mode/gh-pages/data/kk-index-b-works-sub-element-network.rds) |
| `kk-index-b-works-heading-network.rds` | works × headings (igraph) | [download](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olizardo/definitions-of-culture-two-mode/gh-pages/data/kk-index-b-works-heading-network.rds) |

## Reading the files in R

```r
library(igraph)

base <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olizardo/definitions-of-culture-two-mode/gh-pages/data/"
defs <- readRDS(gzcon(url(paste0(base, "kk-index-b-verified-network.rds"))))
g_defs <- defs$graph
m_defs <- defs$biadjacency

g_works <- readRDS(gzcon(url(paste0(base, "kk-index-b-works-sub-element-network.rds"))))
```

The definitions files are lists. Take `$graph` for the igraph object and `$biadjacency` for the 0/1 matrix. The works files are igraph objects directly. The work table is not included, but each work vertex carries its `codes`, `n_codes`, `n_concepts`, `year`, `decade`, and `label` attributes.
